statement: Let L be a CM number field and l an odd prime other than 5. Let r : GL → GL2(Ql) be continuous, unramified outside finitely many places, with determinant ϵ−1 l . Suppose that r is potentially semistable with labeled Hodge–Tate weights 0, 1 at every v | l, that r is decomposed generic, and that r|GL(ζl) is absolutely irreducible. Suppose there are a cuspidal weight-zero regular algebraic representation π of PGL2(AL) and an isomorphism ι : Ql ∼ − → C for which rι(π) ≃ r. At each v | l, assume one of the following: (i) Both local Galois representations are potentially crystalline; one is potentially ordinary of weight zero if and only if the other is; and recLv (πv) has zero monodromy. (ii) Neither local Galois representation is potentially crystalline, and π is ι-ordinary of weight zero at v. Then r ≃ rι(Π) for a cuspidal weight-zero regular algebraic representation Π of PGL2(AL).
